title: Cruise ship, stairwell, elevators
content: My mall world dreams have become more intense and eerie recently and I’m discovering new places. I’m curious if anyone has experienced any of these places? Or changes in their dreams in general? 1. There’s now a cruise ship in my mall world dreams. It is HUGE. Last night, the ship basically lost control and drove? onto land destroying the entire town. Then there was a huge cliff that it fell down (I woke up before the impact, but holy shit it was terrifying.) 2. Stairwell: the stairwells have been a bit different lately. There’s also a new pool room, but the pool is empty. Something about it feels super eerie. 3. The elavators have been much more present recently. They’ve also been acting up and causing so much stress in my dreams hahah
